_comment: UITraps MCP Server — client configuration examples.
_setup_instructions: 1. Get your API key from your UITraps subscription dashboard.
2. Copy the block for your AI client below into its config file.
3. Replace YOUR_API_KEY_HERE with your actual key.
4. Replace the URL with your Railway deployment URL (or http://localhost:8080 for local dev).

claude_code._command: Run this in your terminal, then restart Claude Code:
claude_code._run: claude mcp add uitraps --transport sse https://YOUR-APP.railway.app/mcp/sse --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'

local_dev._note: For local development (backend running on port 8080):

available_tools.analyze_screenshots: Analyze 1–10 UI screenshots. 1 credit per image.
available_tools.analyze_figma: Analyze a Figma file by URL. 1 credit per frame.
available_tools.analyze_pdf: Analyze a PDF document. 1 credit per page.
available_tools.analyze_video: Analyze a screen recording. 1 credit per extracted frame.
available_tools.ask_about_traps: Ask questions about the UI Traps framework. Free.
